purpose: Teach: 公庫/汎用/中級/勘案/解禁/焼却/税法/公述

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、政策金融公庫から借入をされたぞ
lines.en: When your father founded the company, he borrowed from the government lending institution.
lines.style: Quiet, measured recollection. A statement of fact delivered with gentle weight. Pace unhurried, as if turning over a memory from decades back. Slight pause before speaking, the way someone does when retrieving something important from deep memory.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは汎用品から始められました
lines.en: Yes. My father started with general merchandise.
lines.style: Respectful affirmation. Direct eye contact held steady. Voice warm but restrained—not defensive, but honoring the moment. Slight emphasis on 'started' as if acknowledging how far the company has come since then.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、社員に中級資格を取らせる支援をなさった
lines.en: Your father supported his staff in earning intermediate certifications.
lines.style: Slow, deliberate pacing. A note of tenderness underneath—recognizing something about the man's character. Voice slightly softer on 'supported,' as if still moved by that generosity of spirit.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは複数の要因を勘案して経営なさいました
lines.en: Yes. My father made decisions by weighing many different factors.
lines.style: Measured, thoughtful. Voice carries quiet conviction without arrogance. Slight pause between thoughts, as if considering each word before offering it. Humble but not self-diminishing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、新商品の解禁時にお祝いを開いたぞ
lines.en: Your father held a celebration when the new product launched.
lines.style: Voice touches affection lightly. A memory that still brings warmth. Pace steady but with a subtle lift near the end—the kind of lift that comes from remembering something joyful. Slight trailing softness, like a smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。古書類の焼却もお父さんが指示されました
lines.en: Yes. My father also instructed us to dispose of the old records.
lines.style: Even tone, grounded. Voice carries neither celebration nor burden—just the matter-of-fact recitation of what was done. A detail offered because it was part of the whole. Brief, clear, respectful.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、税法改正をふまえて社員に説明された
lines.en: Your father explained the tax law changes to his staff.
lines.style: Gentle acknowledgment of care. Voice slightly warmer here—recognizing the work involved in keeping people informed. Pace unhurried, as if honoring the effort it took. Soft, remembering.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは業界団体で公述もなさいました
lines.en: Yes. My father also gave testimony for the industry association.
lines.style: Final statement delivered with quiet finality and weight. Voice steady and clear. A gentle close—respectful, complete. Slight breath before the final phrase, as if this detail brings the picture into full view. Composed and honoring.
